Moi! Mä oon Emilia. Hauska tutustua!

Hi! I'm Emilia. Nice to meet you!

I'm a passionate Finnish language teacher from Jyväskylä, Finland. I hold a master's degree from the University of Jyväskylä with a strong focus on Finnish as a second language. Over the past three years, I've successfully helped students achieve their goals at the University of Jyväskylä, Summer University of Jyväskylä, Jyväskylä Adult Education Centre and in integration training. Since autumn 2025, I've been offering tailored private Finnish lessons at all levels for several students.

My teaching is clear, versatile and engaging. I'm driven by a genuine desire to make language learning meaningful — I also aim to give the tools to truly understand our wonderful culture and be a part of it. I always teach with an inspiring attitude and a touch of typical Finnish humor; I promise you won't get bored learning Finnish with me!
